mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% (2-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month sustained increase in federal funds rate above 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer demand and housing market activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS decline and HOUST rise) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 0.5% signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 4.0% periods, the signal (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 108.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, correlating with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 108.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in consumer price inflation below 2.5% signals easing price pressures, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates coordinated monetary and credit easing, stimulating economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and RSAFS rise) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-industrial-production regimes (INDPRO > 108.0), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals construction sector slowdown, reducing near-term economic growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO > 108.0 periods, the signal (HOUST decline) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
